spec.description: Volumes, physical disks, drives and Storage Spaces of one Windows host.
Used space of the fullest selected volume. Free-space counters can lag by 10 to 15 minutes.
spec.title: Fullest volume

spec.description: Bytes read per second, summed over the selected volumes.
spec.title: Read

spec.description: Bytes written per second, summed over the selected volumes.
spec.title: Write

spec.description: Read and write operations per second, summed over the selected volumes.
spec.title: IOPS

spec.expr: ((sum(rate(windows_logical_disk_read_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", volume=~"$volume"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(windows_logical_disk_write_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", volume=~"$volume"}[$__rate_interval]))) / ((sum(rate(windows_logical_disk_reads_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", volume=~"$volume"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(windows_logical_disk_writes_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", volume=~"$volume"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0)) or (0 * sum(rate(windows_logical_disk_reads_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", volume=~"$volume"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.description: Average time per read or write operation over the selected volumes. 0 when there is no I/O.
spec.title: Latency

spec.description: Busy time of the busiest physical disk. Requires the physical_disk collector.
spec.title: Busiest disk

spec.description: Drives whose operational status is not OK. Requires the diskdrive collector.
spec.title: Drives not OK

spec.description: Model, size, partitions and operational status of each drive. Requires the diskdrive collector.
spec.title: Drives

spec.expr: (1 - clamp_max(rate(windows_physical_disk_idle_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]), 1)) * on (disk) group_left (model) max by (disk, model) (label_replace(windows_diskdrive_info{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}, "disk", "$1", "name", "PHYSICALDRIVE(\\d+)")) or on (disk) (1 - clamp_max(rate(windows_physical_disk_idle_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]), 1))

spec.description: Share of time each physical disk was servicing requests (1 - idle time). Requires the physical_disk collector; the diskdrive collector adds drive models.
spec.title: Disk busy time

spec.expr: (rate(windows_physical_disk_write_bytes_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (disk) group_left (model) max by (disk, model) (label_replace(windows_diskdrive_info{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}, "disk", "$1", "name", "PHYSICALDRIVE(\\d+)")) or on (disk) (rate(windows_physical_disk_write_bytes_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

(rate(windows_physical_disk_read_bytes_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (disk) group_left (model) max by (disk, model) (label_replace(windows_diskdrive_info{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}, "disk", "$1", "name", "PHYSICALDRIVE(\\d+)")) or on (disk) (rate(windows_physical_disk_read_bytes_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: Bytes read and written per second by each physical disk. Reads are drawn below the axis. Requires the physical_disk collector; the diskdrive collector adds drive models.
spec.title: Disk throughput

spec.expr: (rate(windows_physical_disk_writes_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (disk) group_left (model) max by (disk, model) (label_replace(windows_diskdrive_info{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}, "disk", "$1", "name", "PHYSICALDRIVE(\\d+)")) or on (disk) (rate(windows_physical_disk_writes_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

(rate(windows_physical_disk_reads_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (disk) group_left (model) max by (disk, model) (label_replace(windows_diskdrive_info{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}, "disk", "$1", "name", "PHYSICALDRIVE(\\d+)")) or on (disk) (rate(windows_physical_disk_reads_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: Read and write operations per second by each physical disk. Reads are drawn below the axis. Requires the physical_disk collector; the diskdrive collector adds drive models.
spec.title: Disk IOPS

spec.expr: (rate(windows_physical_disk_write_latency_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) / (rate(windows_physical_disk_writes_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0)) * on (disk) group_left (model) max by (disk, model) (label_replace(windows_diskdrive_info{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}, "disk", "$1", "name", "PHYSICALDRIVE(\\d+)")) or on (disk) (rate(windows_physical_disk_write_latency_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) / (rate(windows_physical_disk_writes_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0))

(rate(windows_physical_disk_read_latency_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) / (rate(windows_physical_disk_reads_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0)) * on (disk) group_left (model) max by (disk, model) (label_replace(windows_diskdrive_info{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}, "disk", "$1", "name", "PHYSICALDRIVE(\\d+)")) or on (disk) (rate(windows_physical_disk_read_latency_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) / (rate(windows_physical_disk_reads_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0))

spec.description: Average time per read and write operation of each physical disk. Reads are drawn below the axis. Requires the physical_disk collector; the diskdrive collector adds drive models.
spec.title: Disk latency

spec.expr: (windows_physical_disk_requests_queued{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}) * on (disk) group_left (model) max by (disk, model) (label_replace(windows_diskdrive_info{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}, "disk", "$1", "name", "PHYSICALDRIVE(\\d+)")) or on (disk) (windows_physical_disk_requests_queued{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"})

spec.description: Requests outstanding on each physical disk at the time of the scrape. A queue that stays high while latency rises indicates a disk bottleneck. Requires the physical_disk collector; the diskdrive collector adds drive models.
spec.title: Disk queue length

spec.expr: (rate(windows_physical_disk_split_ios_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (disk) group_left (model) max by (disk, model) (label_replace(windows_diskdrive_info{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}, "disk", "$1", "name", "PHYSICALDRIVE(\\d+)")) or on (disk) (rate(windows_physical_disk_split_ios_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: I/O requests per second that Windows split into multiple requests, because of a fragmented volume or a request too large for a single I/O. Requires the physical_disk collector; the diskdrive collector adds drive models.
spec.title: Split I/O

spec.expr: count((windows_storage_spaces_pool_health_status{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"} * on (job, instance, unique_id) group_left () windows_storage_spaces_pool_info{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", primordial="false"}) != 0) or (0 * count(windows_storage_spaces_pool_info{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", primordial="false"}))

spec.description: Storage pools whose health status is not Healthy, excluding the primordial pool. Requires the storage_spaces collector.
spec.title: Pools not OK

spec.description: Virtual disks whose health status is not Healthy. Requires the storage_spaces collector with its virtual_disk subcollector.
spec.title: Virtual disks not OK

spec.expr: max by (name) ((windows_storage_spaces_pool_health_status{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"} * on (job, instance, unique_id) group_left () windows_storage_spaces_pool_info{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", primordial="false"}))

max by (name) ((windows_storage_spaces_pool_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"} * on (job, instance, unique_id) group_left () windows_storage_spaces_pool_info{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", primordial="false"}))

max by (name) ((windows_storage_spaces_pool_allocated_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"} * on (job, instance, unique_id) group_left () windows_storage_spaces_pool_info{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", primordial="false"}))

max by (name) (100 * (windows_storage_spaces_pool_allocated_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"} * on (job, instance, unique_id) group_left () windows_storage_spaces_pool_info{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", primordial="false"}) / (windows_storage_spaces_pool_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"} * on (job, instance, unique_id) group_left () windows_storage_spaces_pool_info{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", primordial="false"}))

spec.description: Health, size, allocated capacity and used share of each storage pool, excluding the primordial pool of unpooled disks. Requires the storage_spaces collector.
spec.title: Storage pools

spec.description: Health, size, allocated capacity, pool footprint and storage efficiency (allocated size per pool footprint) of each virtual disk. Mirrors and parity lower the efficiency. Requires the storage_spaces collector with its virtual_disk subcollector.
spec.title: Virtual disks

spec.expr: 100 * (windows_storage_spaces_pool_allocated_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"} * on (job, instance, unique_id) group_left () windows_storage_spaces_pool_info{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", primordial="false"}) / (windows_storage_spaces_pool_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"} * on (job, instance, unique_id) group_left () windows_storage_spaces_pool_info{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", primordial="false"})

spec.description: Allocated share of each storage pool, excluding the primordial pool. A full pool cannot extend thin-provisioned virtual disks, which then fail writes.
spec.title: Pool usage

spec.description: Pool capacity consumed by each virtual disk, including resiliency copies.
spec.title: Virtual disk footprint

spec.expr: max by (volume, volume_name, disk, filesystem) (windows_logical_disk_info{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", volume=~"$volume"})

spec.description: Label, physical disk number, file system, size, available space and used percentage of each selected logical volume. Windows free-space counters can lag by 10 to 15 minutes; use trends rather than treating a single sample as immediate confirmation of reclaimed space.
spec.title: Volumes

spec.description: Used space as a percentage of each selected logical volume. Sustained growth toward full capacity can prevent writes and disrupt applications; Windows free-space counters can lag by 10 to 15 minutes.
spec.title: Volume usage

spec.description: Share of time the volume was servicing requests (1 - idle time).
spec.title: Volume busy time

spec.description: Reads are drawn below the axis.
spec.title: Volume throughput

spec.description: Reads are drawn below the axis.
spec.title: Volume IOPS

spec.description: Average time per read and write operation. Reads are drawn below the axis.
spec.title: Volume latency

spec.description: Average number of read and write requests queued for the volume. Reads are drawn below the axis. A queue that stays high while latency rises indicates a disk bottleneck.
spec.title: Volume queue length
